balances.title: Current balances
balances.noExpenses: There are no expenses recorded for this member
balances.howItWorksIntro: It uses a <algorithm>greedy algorithm</algorithm> to calculate the most efficient way to settle the debts:
balances.step1: 1. It identifies the person with the <maxCredit>highest credit balance</maxCredit> (the one who should receive the most money).
balances.step2: 2. It identifies the person with the <maxDebt>highest debt balance</maxDebt> (the one who owes the most money).
balances.step3: 3. It calculates a transfer for the <minimum>minimum</minimum> between what the debtor owes and what the creditor is owed.
balances.step4: 4. Balances are updated and the process repeats until all debts are settled.
balances.howItWorksConclusion: This algorithm <minimizes>minimizes the total number of transfers</minimizes> needed to bring every balance to zero.
